entities.text: Gadamsetty Venakta Subramanyam vs The State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice A.V.Sesha Sai
 Criminal Petition No.113 Of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by A.1 and A.2 in Crime No.412 of 2018 of Buchireddypalem Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, seeking quashment of the said crime registered for the alleged offences under Sections 188 and 273 I.P.C. and Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.

entities.text: Buchireddypalem Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard Sri Khambhampati Ramesh Babu, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
3.
Both the counsels agreed that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the learned single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judge of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners-A.1 and A.2 in Crime No.412 of 2018 of Buchireddypalem Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188 and 273 I.P.C. and Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Buchireddypalem Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending in this case, shall stand closed.

A.V.SESHA SAI, J 07-01-2020 siva THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE A.V.SESHA SAI CRIMINAL PETITION No.113 OF 2020 Date: 07-01-2020 siva Gadamsetty Venakta Subramanyam vs The State Of Ap on 7 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26251912/
